subject: science
topicName: Writing Formulas and Names of Ionic Compounds
description: A Grade 9 chemistry lesson on simple ionic formulas, charge balance, and -ide naming.
learningObjectives: Write simple ionic formulas from ion charges
Explain why ionic formulas are neutral
Name simple ionic compounds using metal name plus nonmetal -ide
